_comment: VENDORS.md (plural, backslash path) declares lib/widget.min.js and lib/helper.min.js, each from an unpinned unpkg URL. The minified files are recognized as vendored, so missing-library / minified-code / obfuscated-code / code-sanity skip them; unpinned-vendor-source rejects both non-pinned sources, anchored to the VENDORS.md line that cites each one - decided offline, no fetch. The response names no file, so the two share one message and collapse into a single entry with a locus per declaration. bg.js imports both libs, so unused-files leaves them alone.
